note: 十段发布交接双语草稿；设计：固定制品、核实冻结规则与回退证据，接班复述，明确未决审批。未配音，交接确认不代表发布获准。

series.title: 发布值班交接：接班不是发布审批
series.premise: 17:45交接catalog 2.9候选，生产为2.8。18:00至20:00冻结，安全评审与生产审批未完成。
series.outcome: Raj复述并接收值守职责，确认固定制品、冻结窗口、幂等操作及回退条件。安全审核19:30反馈，生产审批仍由Priya负责；冻结解除和全部审批均满足前不得发布。

accentTarget.basis: spoken audio duration excluding silence and narration

recycling.note: 未来候选不计实际复现；本文件只复现已有库、S03至S07及本文件前段。

dialogues.title: 先交清单，再交权限边界
dialogues.premise: 17:45开始交接，catalog候选尚未获生产审批。
dialogues.listeningTask: 听出接班范围和不属于交接授权的操作。

lines.en: Okay, let's hand over release coverage. The release checklist is in our ticket.
lines.zh: 好，交接发布值守。发布清单在工单里。

lines.en: Just to confirm, I'm receiving operational coverage. Not production approval authority itself.
lines.zh: 确认一下，我接的是操作值守，不是生产审批权本身。

lines.en: Correct, production still serves version 2.8. The 2.9 candidate remains in staging.
lines.zh: 对，生产仍是2.8。2.9候选留在预发布环境。

lines.en: The candidate improves catalog lookup speed. It doesn't change order writes today.
lines.zh: 候选改善商品目录查询速度。今天不改订单写入。

lines.en: Don't infer approval from completed tests. My security review remains unfinished today.
lines.zh: 不要从测试完成推断审批。今天我的安全评审仍未结束。

lines.en: What's the ETA for your review? We need an owner and checkpoint.
lines.zh: 你的评审预计何时完成？需要负责人和检查时点。

lines.en: Before timings, verify the checklist version. An old link may omit current restrictions.
lines.zh: 先别说时间，核对清单版本。旧链接可能缺少当前限制。

lines.en: So, just to recap, revision six. Have I missed anything in scope?
lines.zh: 那么小结一下，是第六版。范围里有我漏掉的吗？

lines.en: It includes signed artifact evidence links. They require authenticated access, not public sharing.
lines.zh: 它含有签名制品证据链接。需要认证访问，不能公开分享。

lines.en: Fair, I'll stay for application questions. Let's verify both artifact versions next.
lines.zh: 明白，我留下回答应用问题。接下来核对两版制品。

dialogues.title: 固定摘要与旧版来源一起交接
dialogues.premise: 接班范围和第六版清单已确认，生产2.8，候选2.9。
dialogues.listeningTask: 抓住制品追溯链及不可接受的替代动作。

lines.en: The artifact digest matches the release checklist. I'll deploy no moving tags.
lines.zh: 制品摘要匹配发布清单。我不会用可变标签部署。

lines.en: Okay, just to confirm, both versions retained? Registry retention must cover our rollback window.
lines.zh: 好，确认一下，两版都保留？仓库保留期必须覆盖回滚窗口。

lines.en: Yes, 2.8 remains protected from cleanup. Rebuilding source isn't an equivalent rollback artifact.
lines.zh: 对，2.8受保护不会清理。重建源码不等于同一回退制品。

lines.en: The smoke test used candidate digest directly. Its source commit is linked, right?
lines.zh: 冒烟测试直接用候选摘要。源码提交有链接，对吧？

lines.en: Yes, provenance lists builder and inputs. Both signatures verify against approved signer identities.
lines.zh: 对，来源证明列出构建者和输入。两版签名均匹配批准身份。

lines.en: I'm on it for access verification. My account can read both retained artifacts.
lines.zh: 访问验证我来做。我的账户能读取两份保留制品。

lines.en: Runtime secrets stay outside artifact images. Use managed configuration references, not copied tokens.
lines.zh: 运行时秘密在制品镜像外。用受管配置引用，不复制令牌。

lines.en: So, record access evidence without secret values. Approval will bind this digest specifically.
lines.zh: 那么记录访问证据，不记录秘密值。审批将绑定这个具体摘要。

lines.en: Signature verification doesn't finish security review. Dependency and secret findings still need resolution.
lines.zh: 验证签名不等于安全评审完成。依赖和秘密发现仍需核查。

lines.en: Understood, roughly one remaining review step. I'll attach existing tests rather than rerun blindly.
lines.zh: 明白，大约还剩一个评审步骤。我附上已有测试，不盲目重跑。

dialogues.title: 测试通过，审批仍待完成
dialogues.premise: 两版制品追溯和访问已核实，安全及生产审批仍未完成。
dialogues.listeningTask: 区分证据上传、评审完成与明确签批。

lines.en: Okay, production remains pending approval today. I haven't issued the release go/no-go.
lines.zh: 好，今天生产仍等待审批。我没有给出发布继续许可。

lines.en: Just to confirm, a green checklist isn't approval? I'll check recorded signatures separately.
lines.zh: 确认一下，清单全绿不是审批？我单独查记录的签批。

lines.en: Right, ticket comments can be ambiguous. Require explicit approval for target and digest.
lines.zh: 对，工单评论可能含糊。要求明确批准目标和摘要。

lines.en: My staging signoff covers functional tests only. It doesn't authorize production promotion itself.
lines.zh: 我的预发布签收只覆盖功能测试，本身不授权生产晋级。

lines.en: Security review needs one dependency exception assessed. No secret leak has been identified.
lines.zh: 安全评审还要评估一个依赖例外。目前未发现秘密泄漏。

lines.en: What's the ETA for that assessment? Please close the loop in this ticket.
lines.zh: 那个评估预计多久？请在此工单反馈闭环。

lines.en: If approval times out, leave it blocked. Silence isn't permission to ship anything.
lines.zh: 审批超时就保持阻止。沉默不是发布任何东西的许可。

lines.en: So, the artifact digest stays fixed. Changed content needs renewed review and approval.
lines.zh: 那么制品摘要保持固定。内容变化要重新评审和审批。

lines.en: I'll provide a decision at nineteen-thirty. That may be rejection, not guaranteed approval.
lines.zh: 我十九点三十分给决定。可能拒绝，不保证批准。

lines.en: Fair, I'll be available for clarification. We shouldn't promise a release time yet.
lines.zh: 明白，我会待命澄清。目前不应承诺发布时间。

dialogues.title: 到点解冻不自动触发发布
dialogues.premise: 审批仍待完成，Hannah将在19:30反馈；需核对18:00至20:00冻结。
dialogues.listeningTask: 听出冻结例外和解冻后的审批条件。

lines.en: Okay, release freeze runs eighteen to twenty. Let's freeze changes before that boundary.
lines.zh: 好，发布冻结是十八点到二十点。在边界前冻结变更。

lines.en: Just to confirm, eighteen is a hard stop? Even if approval arrives earlier?
lines.zh: 确认一下，十八点是硬截止？就算更早拿到审批也一样？

lines.en: Correct, today's candidate can't start before freeze. We haven't reserved a safe observation window.
lines.zh: 对，今天候选不能在冻结前开始。没有预留安全观察窗口。

lines.en: And after twenty, approval still matters, right? Unlocking the window doesn't approve deployment.
lines.zh: 二十点后审批仍重要，对吧？窗口解锁不等于批准部署。

lines.en: Emergency mitigation has a separate escalation path. It requires incident approval, not this checklist.
lines.zh: 紧急缓解走独立升级路径。需要故障审批，不是这份清单。

lines.en: Pending approval stays blocked through the freeze. I've disabled scheduled promotion as well.
lines.zh: 待审批状态在冻结期间继续阻止。我也禁用了定时晋级。

lines.en: Verify the controller won't replay queued actions. A timer mustn't bypass the freeze lock.
lines.zh: 核对控制器不会重放排队动作。定时器不能绕过冻结锁。

lines.en: So, I checked the effective lock. No queued production action is present now.
lines.zh: 那么我检查了生效的锁。目前没有排队生产动作。

lines.en: Keep the freeze decision in audit history. Don't alter timestamps to fit an approval.
lines.zh: 冻结决定留在审计历史里。别改时间戳去匹配审批。

lines.en: Fair, support gets a delayed-release update. Not a maybe-live message during this freeze.
lines.zh: 明白，支持团队收到延期更新，不是冻结期间可能上线的消息。

dialogues.title: 兼容检查通过，长尾风险仍在
dialogues.premise: 冻结规则及控制器锁已确认，接着说明候选的已知限制。
dialogues.listeningTask: 抓住已知限制、停放量条件和未证明事项。

lines.en: Our known limitation is large-catalog latency. Small-catalog tests aren't representative enough yet.
lines.zh: 已知限制是大目录延迟。小目录测试还不够有代表性。

lines.en: Okay, release checklist includes that distinction. Just to confirm, no data conversion?
lines.zh: 好，发布清单包含这个区分。确认一下，没有数据转换？

lines.en: Only an optional nullable column was added. Old readers and writers remain compatible.
lines.zh: 只增加一个可空可选列。旧读取和写入代码保持兼容。

lines.en: The mixed-version smoke test passed, right? I'll keep an eye on large catalogs.
lines.zh: 混合版本冒烟测试通过了，对吧？我关注大目录。

lines.en: Yes, including rows the candidate wrote. No column removal is authorized for rollback.
lines.zh: 对，包括候选写出的行。回滚没有获准删列。

lines.en: Pause promotion if p95 exceeds five hundred. Two consecutive minutes trigger that pause.
lines.zh: p95超过五百就暂停放量。连续两分钟触发暂停。

lines.en: Milliseconds, with matched large-catalog request samples. Missing metrics also block any further increase.
lines.zh: 单位毫秒，用匹配的大目录请求样本。指标缺失也阻止继续增加。

lines.en: So, the rollback trigger needs recording too. Confirmed wrong catalog results mean immediate rollback.
lines.zh: 那么也要记录回滚触发条件。确认目录结果错误就立即回滚。

lines.en: Errors above one percent pause after two minutes. Above two percent for five means rollback. Raj must review those before execution.
lines.zh: 错误率超过1%持续两分钟就暂停，超过2%持续五分钟就回滚。Raj执行前必须评审这些条件。

lines.en: Fair, they're recorded, not improvised tonight. I'll verify alert routing before taking coverage.
lines.zh: 明白，它们已记录，不是今晚临时想。我接班前验证告警路由。

dialogues.title: 主值班和后备都要真正可达
dialogues.premise: 已知大目录风险和观察门槛已记录，需落实今晚值守。
dialogues.listeningTask: 听出主值班、后备、应用联系人和升级时点。

lines.en: Okay, the coverage roster names Raj. He's primary on-call from eighteen tonight.
lines.zh: 好，覆盖名单列明Raj。他今晚十八点起主值班。

lines.en: Just to confirm, Lukas is my backup? We tested the paging route, right?
lines.zh: 确认一下，Lukas是后备？我们测过呼叫路由，对吧？

lines.en: Yes, test notification reached my phone. Page the backup after five unanswered minutes.
lines.zh: 对，测试通知到了我手机。五分钟无人回应就呼叫后备。

lines.en: I'll cover application questions until twenty-two. The later application rota is linked too.
lines.zh: 我到二十二点负责应用问题。之后应用轮值也有链接。

lines.en: Security contact remains me through review. Suspected credential exposure needs immediate security escalation.
lines.zh: 评审期间安全联系人仍是我。疑似凭据泄漏立即升级安全团队。

lines.en: What's the ETA for access confirmation? Don't wait for an alert to discover gaps.
lines.zh: 访问确认预计多久？别等告警才发现权限缺口。

lines.en: Raj has dashboard and rollback access. Approval permissions are intentionally excluded from that role.
lines.zh: Raj有面板和回滚访问权。这个角色故意不含审批权限。

lines.en: So, I verified the escalation path. My test alert reached both named operators.
lines.zh: 那么我验证了升级路径。测试告警到达两位指定操作员。

lines.en: Contact details stay in authenticated directories. Don't paste personal numbers into public release notes.
lines.zh: 联系方式留在认证目录里。别在公开发布说明贴个人号码。

lines.en: Fair, coverage looks complete for tonight. Let's check the rollback procedure before questions.
lines.zh: 明白，今晚值守看起来完整。提问前先查回滚流程。

dialogues.title: 入口可用，但重试必须核对状态
dialogues.premise: 值守名单、告警路由和权限已验证；演示回退入口但不执行。
dialogues.listeningTask: 分清预演与真实操作，以及结果未知时的处理。

lines.en: The rollback entry point is this runbook. It selects the retained 2.8 digest.
lines.zh: 回退入口是这份运行手册。它选择保留的2.8摘要。

lines.en: Okay, dry-run it first without applying. Just to confirm, artifact digest stays fixed?
lines.zh: 好，先预演不执行。确认一下，制品摘要固定？

lines.en: Yes, reverify signatures before real execution. Stale verification records aren't a permanent exception.
lines.zh: 对，真实执行前再验签。旧验证记录不是永久豁免。

lines.en: Keep expanded schema during rollback, right? Mixed-version compatibility evidence is linked beside it.
lines.zh: 回滚时保留扩展结构，对吧？旁边有混合版本兼容证据链接。

lines.en: Correct, managed configuration restores runtime references. No copying secret values between versions.
lines.zh: 对，受管配置恢复运行时引用。不在版本间复制秘密值。

lines.en: The rollback trigger permits approved mitigation only. Routine release freeze still blocks new rollout.
lines.zh: 回退触发只允许批准的缓解。常规冻结仍阻止新发布。

lines.en: Unknown outcomes need receipt and controller checks. Blind retries might duplicate external actions.
lines.zh: 结果未知要查回执和控制器。盲目重试可能重复外部动作。

lines.en: So, preserve the original operation key. Attempt identifiers can differ for audit tracking.
lines.zh: 那么保留原操作键。尝试标识可不同以跟踪审计。

lines.en: The dry run validates target and access. It does not modify production state.
lines.zh: 预演验证目标和访问权。不修改生产状态。

lines.en: Fair, I'll verify business requests after rollback. Green pods alone won't demonstrate correct results.
lines.zh: 明白，回滚后我验证业务请求。Pod全绿不能单独证明结果正确。

dialogues.title: 接班者复述并澄清自动动作
dialogues.premise: 回退入口已预演，未执行生产操作；Raj开始复述并提问。
dialogues.listeningTask: 听出复述中的误解如何被纠正。

lines.en: Okay, I'll read back the plan. Let me play that back before acceptance.
lines.zh: 好，我复述计划。接收前先复述确认。

lines.en: We're ready to hand over coverage. Start with what you won't execute.
lines.zh: 我们准备好交接值守。先说你不会执行什么。

lines.en: Include the exact freeze boundary too. The controller lock remains a separate safeguard.
lines.zh: 也说准确冻结边界。控制器锁仍是独立保障。

lines.en: Release freeze ends at twenty tonight. Then 2.9 starts automatically... no, that's wrong.
lines.zh: 发布冻结今晚二十点结束。然后2.9自动开始……不，这不对。

lines.en: Right, explicit approvals must also exist. Freeze expiry doesn't fulfill security or release approval.
lines.zh: 对，还必须有明确审批。冻结到期不满足安全或发布审批。

lines.en: Just to confirm, tests cover both versions. Data compatibility stays required during rollback itself.
lines.zh: 确认一下，测试覆盖两版。回滚本身仍要求数据兼容。

lines.en: And retain the old artifact without rebuilding. Unknown deployment state requires reconciliation before retries.
lines.zh: 保留旧制品，不重建。部署状态未知先核对再重试。

lines.en: So, fixed digests and no secret copying. Have I missed anything about approvals?
lines.zh: 那么固定摘要，不复制秘密。审批方面有我遗漏的吗？

lines.en: Approval must name this target environment. A staging signoff doesn't transfer to production.
lines.zh: 审批必须写明目标环境。预发布签收不能转成生产审批。

lines.en: Fair, that correction matters for tonight. Let's name each unresolved owner explicitly now.
lines.zh: 明白，这个纠正今晚很重要。现在明确每个未决负责人的名字。

dialogues.title: 安全反馈与生产审批分别追踪
dialogues.premise: Raj已纠正自动发布误解；最后确认未决评审和审批负责人。
dialogues.listeningTask: 区分给出决定的时点与保证批准的承诺。

lines.en: Okay, who's picking this up for security? Hannah remains that approval owner tonight.
lines.zh: 好，安全这块谁接？今晚Hannah仍是审批负责人。

lines.en: Just to confirm, production stays pending approval. You're the release approver after security, right?
lines.zh: 确认一下，生产仍等待审批。安全之后你负责发布审批，对吧？

lines.en: Even security acceptance won't approve production alone. Both decisions need recorded scope and evidence.
lines.zh: 安全接受也不能单独批准生产。两项决定都要记录范围和证据。

lines.en: What's the ETA for dependency clarification? I'll attach the affected package's actual usage.
lines.zh: 依赖澄清预计多久？我附上受影响包的实际用途。

lines.en: I need that by nineteen tonight. I'll post my decision at nineteen-thirty.
lines.zh: 今晚十九点前需要。十九点三十分我发决定。

lines.en: I'll close the loop after that decision. No approval from me before reviewing it.
lines.zh: 那个决定出来后我反馈闭环。没评审之前我不批准。

lines.en: If either owner misses the checkpoint, escalate. Don't substitute another person's casual agreement.
lines.zh: 任何负责人错过检查时点都升级。不能用别人随口同意替代。

lines.en: So, I'll chase the checkpoint directly. We can delay instead of forcing approval.
lines.zh: 那么我直接跟踪检查时点。可以延期，不强行推动审批。

lines.en: And new findings may change the decision. My deadline promises feedback, not acceptance.
lines.zh: 新发现可能改变决定。截止承诺的是反馈，不是接受。

lines.en: Fair, I'll tell stakeholders it's still blocked. Their launch notice waits for explicit authorization.
lines.zh: 明白，我告诉相关方仍阻止发布。上线通知等待明确授权。

dialogues.title: 接收值守，保留全部发布限制
dialogues.premise: 负责人和反馈时点已确认，当前仍17:55，生产审批未给出。
dialogues.listeningTask: 听出最终复述、交接确认和仍未解除的限制。

lines.en: Okay, handoff accepted for operational coverage. I've got it from here at eighteen.
lines.zh: 好，操作值守交接已接收。十八点起由我接手。

lines.en: Just to confirm, read back the plan. Include release restrictions in your acceptance.
lines.zh: 确认一下，复述计划。接收时包含发布限制。

lines.en: I'll remain backup through the shift. The runbook and access tests are recorded.
lines.zh: 这个班我继续后备。运行手册和访问测试已记录。

lines.en: Just to recap, production remains 2.8. Candidate 2.9 cannot ship during freeze itself.
lines.zh: 小结一下，生产仍是2.8。冻结本身期间2.9候选不能发布。

lines.en: My security decision arrives at nineteen-thirty. It isn't currently an approval to deploy.
lines.zh: 我的安全决定十九点三十分给出。目前它不是部署审批。

lines.en: I'll provide dependency details by nineteen. I'll keep an eye on application questions.
lines.zh: 十九点前我提供依赖细节。我关注应用问题。

lines.en: Rollback retains schema and verified old digest. Unknown action outcomes stay held until reconciled.
lines.zh: 回滚保留结构和验证过的旧摘要。动作结果未知就挂起直到核对。

lines.en: So, after twenty needs both approvals. Same digest, same target, no silent substitutions.
lines.zh: 那么二十点后需要两项审批。同一摘要、同一目标，不暗自替换。

lines.en: Correct, keep secrets in approved storage. Suspected exposure requires revocation and security escalation.
lines.zh: 对，秘密留在批准存储中。疑似泄漏需要撤销和安全升级。

lines.en: Fair, I confirm coverage handoff only. No production release is approved by this conversation.
lines.zh: 明白，我只确认值守交接。本次对话没有批准任何生产发布。
